stacking.title: How it combines with other offers
stacking.intro: Choose what may run together with this promotion in one cart. The shop applies the same rules for every customer.

headline.delivery: Free delivery is judged on its own
headline.StacksWithOrderPromotions: Combines with other cart promotions, not with a coupon
headline.StacksWithCoupon: Combines with cart promotions and with a coupon that allows it

points.deliveryIndependent: Free delivery counts the goods value after promotions and coupon. It is never dropped when a coupon wins, and the stacking choice does not change it.
points.lineLowestWins: On one item, the sale price and price promotions do not add up: the lowest price wins. A tie goes to the higher priority, then the older promotion.
points.orderPriority: Bundles and buy X get Y run on the item prices in priority order, higher first. An item is used by at most one bundle and at most one buy X get Y.
points.exclusiveAlone: No other bundle or buy X get Y runs in the same cart.
points.exclusiveNoCoupon: A coupon is not combined with it either.
points.combinesOrder: It can run together with other cart promotions that are not set to Alone. If two cannot combine, the larger saving wins.
points.combinesNone: It does not combine with another price promotion on the same item.
points.couponStacks: A coupon can be added on top, if the coupon itself allows combining with promotions.
points.couponNeedsFlag: Every promotion that applies must allow a coupon. If one does not, the customer gets the better of promotions only or the coupon only, never both.
points.couponBetterOf: A coupon is not added on top. The customer gets the better of promotions only or the coupon on normal prices, never both. A tie keeps the promotions.

stacking.sameForAll: Two coupons never combine. A price never goes below 0.

actions.archiveBody: It stops and leaves the shop, but stays in the reports and on orders that used it. It cannot be changed afterwards, only copied.
